notes.title: Dev Blog #165 - SRS Concert, Trendy Summer Outfits, Companions & Mini Quad Bike!
notes.content:
Hello, Atomians!

The 27.1 Update is here! And we are excited to present SALT RIVER SHAKEDOWN musical event this weekend!
The event starts Friday 16th August 3PM BST / 9AM CST / 7AM PST and will continue all weekend.
SALT RIVER SHAKEDOWN
https://i.imgur.com/l9Zau5l.jpg
Please welcome the emerging UK Hard Rockers, Scottish four-piece SALT RIVER SHAKEDOWN! The project is relatively new but the members of the band have previously played together under the guise, Magic Trik. Fueled with an uncompromising persistence to play for crowds whenever and wherever possible, the band gives their all at every show, and this mantra is earning the live-wired foursome a formidable reputation. Their 1st Virtual Concert in Atom Universe is not to be missed!
Trendy Summer
https://i.imgur.com/BGjSM64.jpg
Brand New Trendy Summer Collection is here: clothes, shoes, accessories and hair. Have a great summer!
New Companions
https://i.imgur.com/7X3mG5Z.jpg
-Bear with me! :) The great brown bear is a fearsome new companion. Plus, we have a surprise companion for subscribers. Find out what it is.
Mini Quad Bike
https://i.imgur.com/BAZ40D4.jpg
Hit the slopes with the Mini Quad Bike from VEEMEE, the newest vehicle in Atom Universe' collection.

Have a great day and see you in Atom Universe!

notes.title: Dev Blog #164 – Lighthouse, Unicorn Locomotion, Summer Clothes, Hair & Accessories!
notes.content:
Hello, Atomians!

The new 27.0 Update is now live! It's bursting with variable content: a new private space, a locomotion, clothes, hair and accessories. We are also pleased to announce the 1st version of Voice Chat in private conversations. It's optional and can be started and stopped at any time. You can have a voice chat and be anywhere in the game. Press L (Left Analog) to start a voice chat; O (Circle) to mute. You can switch between multiple voice chats in your open private conversations.
https://i.imgur.com/jFnefU9.jpg
Lighthouse Private Space
https://i.imgur.com/DUkBHgf.jpg
The Luxury Lighthouse private space is spread across multiple floors and comes beautifully furnished with everything you need. Situated on a picturesque cliffside, this is the perfect getaway.
Unicorn Locomotion
https://i.imgur.com/iNXZUrX.jpg
Great news for Unicorn lovers! You can now ride a magical Unicorn in Atom Universe.
New Summer Clothes, Hair & Accessories
https://i.imgur.com/VAv2NWk.jpg
There is a variety of new summer accessories, hairstyles, and clothes to choose from in the new update. Look for the *Summer Fun* category in the Avatar Tab,

Have a great weekend and see you in Atom Universe!

notes.title: Dev Blog #124 - Atom Universe' 2nd Birthday, World Dances & 1000 Molecules Winner!
notes.content:
Hello Atomians and welcome to the blog!

The winner of our last week's Facebook competition is John Burdall. The prize is 1000 molecules. Congratulations to John! Contact us on Facebook to get your prize.
Atom Universe' 2nd Birthday!
https://i.imgur.com/uAFSaBR.jpg
The Birthday Cake is ready, so it's time to Party! Let's Dance! Birthday Event starts Friday 28 Sep in Crowbots.
This week we are offering 50% DISCOUNT on 5 Most Popular Dance Packs!
World Dances!
https://i.imgur.com/Uw9xD76.jpg
On our Birthday Weekend, we are releasing six Traditional Dances from around the globe: Greek, Russian, Japanese, Egyptian, Irish & Bhangra. All the new collection of dances is motion-captured and feels very smooth and rhythmic at the same time. Gloria Estefan's words still ring true: The rhythm is gonna get you.
Daily Atoms
https://i.imgur.com/ewcIurz.jpg
We have recently reduced the number of atoms you need to play all Atom Universe games.
Daily Atoms rewards have changed as well. Here are the new daily atoms.
Normal User (from day 1 to day 5) = [ 25, 30, 40, 60, 75 ];
Subscriber = 100 Atoms daily;
Playstation Plus User = [ 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 ];
Subscriber and Playstation Plus User = [ 100, 120, 130, 140, 150 ].

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Dev Blog #78 - Are you feeling lucky? Friday 13th, review of the year video and new items!
notes.content:
Hello my lovely Atomians!

That Lakeview Retreat eh? What a catch! We can't wait to bring it to you so keep an eye out for more news on its development.

Anyway, let's dive straight in because we have some awesome new things to share!


Friday 13th...unlucky for some...

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Flyer-copy.jpg


Is this the unluckiest day ever? Friday 13th is bad enough but to have one in OCTOBER!!! Whewww! 

Well don't despair, you can turn it into a good 'un by joining us for our party on Friday from 8pm UK time.

It will be hosted by our lovely guides and we are sure you are going to have a great time...unless anything BAD happens...mwuhahahahahahahhahahhahahahah!

We're going to have spooky themed music and an exclusive free t-shirt, only available if you join us in game on Friday 13th October! Trade in 1 Atom for your t-shirt, and you can wear it all year if you are that unlucky :).
 

Scarf t-shirts are back!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/13thOctoberClothes.jpg


We haven't released one for a while, but one of your favourite items is back with a new design. Have a look at this crazy tie-dye pattern with a customisable scarf. Available on the tight t-shirt for Adam and Eve, so again we are going a little old school on this one. We know some of you prefer the tight t-shirt for Adam, so watch out for more of that design in future updates.

We also have a soccer shirt for Adam and Eve and check out this smart little t-shirt for Adam with a flower patterned pocket, very stylish.

We know that Eve players loved the skirt with stripy leggings underneath, so here's another to make you smile, this one has rainbow stripy leggings.

New clothing available from midnight tonight (UK time).
 


Bundles of Joy

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/ZombieBundle-copy.jpg


Another bundle is on its way! We have gathered together all the Zombie items we released earlier in the year for this special bundle just in time for Friday 13th October and Halloween. There's one for Adam and one for Eve. 

Remember our bundles will work out an individual price for you based on what you already own, so it is guaranteed good value for everyone!

They're available NOW so use your braiiiiinsssssss and get your zombie on ;) 



One Last Look at our Awesome Year!

So we have come to the end of our birthday activities. We had a wonderful time celebrating our 1-year anniversary- my favourite bit was the giant cake, what was yours?
There's still time to have one last look back over the year, so join us in celebrating what we have achieved together by watching this jam-packed video!

We would like to say a massive THAAAAANKS! to community members Orange Crush 83, Abiatha, RosieMoon, and our Guides Luuk and Guardian Hawk for contributing footage to this video.


https://youtu.be/5fi_BByT8IQ


So that's it for this week, we are going to scurry away and get cracking on what's next! Keep your eyes peeled for details on our Halloween events and keep dreaming of the lovely Lakeview Retreat <3

Bye for now!

notes.title: Dev Blog #77 - News from Sub D Studio and Design a Christmas Jumper!
notes.content:
Hello you lovely people!

It's all go here at Atom HQ, we never stop bringing you awesome new content!
We've got another great release with cool new clothing, free items and exciting news about another space coming to Atom Universe!
Read on for all the juicy details!



Sub D does it again!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Lakeside_Retreat_01.png


They brought you the chic Mirage house and the cool Cave House and now our friends SubD Studio have something else to show you! They have recently sent us images of their latest space, Lakeview Retreat, which will be coming to Atom Universe soon. 

Check out these work in progress images...do they bring back any memories? Lakeview Retreat is an homage to the popular log cabin in PlayStation®Home.

This wooden cabin set by the shore of a beautiful lake will both inspire you and keep you cosy through the misty early mornings.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Lakeview-Retreat.png

We are so excited about this space, it's really beautiful, great to explore and we hope it will make a great holiday home for you.

Keep an eye on future devblogs for more information about when it will be released, plus look out for our next newsletter where we will release more exclusive images of Lakeview Retreat!
 


Get dressed in style


Here's our latest clothing releases, arriving in game from midnight tonight (UK time).

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/tropical-clothes-copy.jpg

We're going totally topical with this t-shirt for Adam and strapless dress for Eve. If it's turning colder where you live, fake the summer with these and stay in the holiday party mood!

And if tropical isn't your thing, what about stripes? We have a striped polo shirt for Adam and a skirt with striped leggings for Eve.
All of the above items are colour customisable so get creative!
 


Free for all

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/NoxuuBandTshirt-copy.jpg


We're adding more free band t-shirts for you to show your support. Check out these Noxxu t-shirts for Adam and Eve. They're colour customisable too so you can adapt them to suit your mood!




Christmas jumper competition - We want your designs!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/xmas-jumper-design-copy.jpg

Get involved with our latest design competition. This time we would like you to design an image to go onto the front of a Christmas jumper!

The winning design will be added to the game for Adam and Eve and will be a free item for all. Plus the winner will be credited in game, so everyone will know they are wearing a design that YOU created!

Get involved and create a seasonal classic and a piece of AU history :)

To submit your design visit our facebook page or reply to our post on twitter

Our 5 Simple Rules:

1) Create an image of your own making (No Copyrighted Images) with a Christmas theme.
2) Think carefully about what you include, small details or text will be very hard to see clearly.
3) Image size must be no larger than 300x300 pixels
4) Submit your own designs in the comments below this post.
5) Only original designs will be accepted. We cannot accept copyrighted images.
There will be ONLY ONE winning design chosen

The competition closes at 23:59pm (UK time) on Tuesday 10th October.


See you next week!
 

Bug Fixes

	Fixed an issue where the menu in game would become laggy if there were lots of people in the space. Have reinstated 32 person servers as a result.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/best-memories-contest-copy.jpg

notes.title: Dev blog #75 - 0.10.0.4150 New Patch! Plus celebrate our birthday with sales, gifts, parties and more!
notes.content:
Wonderful news, Atomians! Our latest patch is here, and our 1st birthday has arrived!

We can finally share with you all the exciting things we have planned to celebrate this marvellous milestone. Plus we have a new public space; oodles of new items; super sales; generous gifts; a slick new tutorial; and even more exciting, we have brought molecules to the PC version, so now it is possible to buy items when you play on PC!

We have been so busy working on all this new content and we are delighted to share it with you, so come on... let's party!
Happy Birthday to *us*!
Just 1 more sleep until our birthday! There's so much awesome birthday stuff I'm going to have to break it down, otherwise you'll miss bits!
Mirage House Pool Party and awesome new birthday items
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Pool-Party.jpg

We've chosen Saturday as our 'official' birthday, but we are starting the celebrations right away with birthday themed clothing and decorations. Host your own birthday pool party in Mirage House, hang up the bunting and balloons and don't forget a giant pile of presents!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Tshirts-and-hat-copy.jpg

Grab one of our birthday t-shirts to show you are in the party mood. These shirts also double up for when it is your birthday, so you can let everyone know that you are a year older :D (Luckily Adam and Eve don't ever age so no one will really know!)

Put on your free cake hat, delicious! (I told you there would be cake!)

 
Sale On!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Sale.jpg

This weekend just keeps getting better! On Saturday and Sunday to celebrate our birthday we are holding a sale on all items! That's right, everything in the game that you buy with molecules will have an amazing 50% off for this weekend only! Subscribers will get their usual 10% off as well, so this really could be the 'sale of the century'!!!

Don't miss out, make sure you visit us this weekend to take advantage of this amazing offer. Take the chance to treat yourself to that highly desirable item you've had your eye on for a while - you deserve it ;)

 
Happy birthday to *you*!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/gifts-copy.jpg

It's not just *our* 1 year anniversary, some of you have been with us for that long (and even longer) too! So we wanted to say thank you by gifting you some awesome gifts when you reach your 3 month, 6 month and 1 year anniversaries!

The day you reach your anniversary you will receive the appropriate reward plus the bonus subscription. If you have already passed two or more of the anniversaries then you will get each of the items, and the longest bonus subscription (the subscriptions will not add up, sorry!). If you already have a subscription, the bonus subscription will kick in once your current subscription has ended.

	3 months - Iridescent baseball cap and 7 day bonus subscription
	6 months - Glowing sole trainers and 14 day bonus subscription
	12 months - Animated fireworks t-shirt and 30 day bonus subscription

Check out the User Profile in the settings tab of the main menu to find out when you joined us and start planning for your anniversary!

 
Fondest memory competition
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/best-memories-contest-copy.jpg

We want to say thank you to all of you who have wished us a happy birthday so far or who have taken part in the competition to share your greatest AU memories. This competition is now closed, now we are going to enjoy reading them all and choosing a winner!

 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Happy-birthday-copy.jpg
Party, Party, Party...
If you didn't have a memory to share yet, how about creating a new one? Something really special will happen at 8PM today UK time to our latest public space (more details below), so make sure you don't miss it.

For the whole week we will be hosting a massive party in this space and while you are at the party you can take part in our new photo competition! We want to see your awesome photos from the party. So get your best party outfit on, invite your crew and pose! Find out how to enter on our Facebook page.

 

 
Our new public space...? It's Crowbots!!!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/WelcomeScreen_Crowbots.png

Crowbots has returned! We have had many requests asking about it and wondering if it would ever come back, so that's what we have done! Crowbots was around in the early days, but if you don't know it, it's a new nightclub with a darker vibe than Arcade Plaza, plus we've added some really interesting interactions with the environment...
I'll let you guys figure them out, but they're super cool!

You can get to it from the spaces tab, or through the door in The Hub, so head over to Crowbots for an edgier experience; chat, dance, glow and have fun in the darkness!

Our mega BIRTHDAY PARTY will take place in here on today at 8PM UK time, until the same time next Saturday, and something very special will happen to the space during that time. Remember we said there might be cake? Well look out for a giant cake! Dance around it... or maybe you will find a way to interact with it ;) There's also a huge slice on the bar for you all to share.

Make sure you join us for the party or in the week following it, as Crowbots will return to normal on Friday 29th September and you will miss the cake!

 
Molecules for all!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Molecules-on-Steam-copy.jpg

Another highly requested feature is to enable molecules on the PC version so that PC users can buy items in the game. We've been working on this and we can now announce that it's here!

Top up your steam wallet and then click on an item that is available for purchase. You will be prompted to add Molecules to your AU account, and then you will be able to purchase anything in the game that requires you to spend molecules.

Think about freshening up your outfit with a snazzy new clothing item or accessory; travelling to distant lands like Aurora Private Islands or Cave House; arranging furniture in your Urban Apartment or Mirage House; or getting your hair cut into one of our awesome gradient designs.

As well as molecules you can now purchase the Christmas, Halloween, Medieval and Japanese DLC packs through Steam; and you can also purchase a subscription!

Having access to molecules unlocks your AU experience and gives you so much more! Have fun exploring your extra options!

 
Let us guide you!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Atom-Universe_20170920161739.jpg

New users will be treated to a tour of some of the key features and spaces in Atom Universe when they first log in. Instead of going to the main menu, a new user will be whisked straight to their Urban Apartment to begin their AU adventure. We want new users to feel more at home when they first arrive, and we hope the tutorial will help them do that. But don't forget, new peeps still need your friendly guidance!

The tutorial will also play for existing users the first time they log in after the patch if they have not verified their email address with us. You only have to play the tutorial once, and all users can replay the tutorial at any time, by clicking on the 'Start Tutorial' button in the Settings tab of the main menu.

 
Improved Reporting
We have added an extra step to reporting so that you can let us know more about why you reported someone. Select Report from the social menu as normal, then choose a reason from the drop down and if you want to, you can type into the box below to give more details.

This will help us to moderate undesirable users and make Atom Universe an even better place to be!

 
Other Bits

	Orb Runner will now cost 10A to play. We hope you enjoyed the free period, but to bring Orb Runner in line with our other games it's time to charge Atoms for it.
Don't forget, Atoms are free and you get more each day you log in. If you log in each day in a row, you get even more Atoms, and subscribers get even more still! If you are getting low, you can take a chance and put it all on Holo-Horses and hope you win big :)
	Flags will now flutter in Aurora Private Islands

 

 

Goodness me! That's one bumper patch all right :)
Get ready for it to drop at 9AM UK time today and be first to explore the new spaces, items and features :)

See you by the giant cake!
Bug Fixes

	Fixed a bug where sometimes Atoms weren't taken when you played games
	Fixed a bug where you couldn't change your clothing if you changed genders through the in-game player menu
	Fixed a bug where the invisi-blocking aspect of blocking wasn't always working properly

We'll be releasing new items into the game tonight at midnight, launching our latest competition and teasing our birthday plans; plus let's have a catch up about last week's exciting activities!


Getting Excited...!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/cake.png

IT'S OUR BIRTHDAY SOON! We are getting really excited here at Atom HQ and we cannot wait to show you all the awesome things we have planned. We want you to celebrate with us, so you can expect lots of gifts, birthday related items, spaces to decorate, special sales, and a huge party in a very special location! We are not telling you too much just yet...but keep Saturday 23rd September free so that you can join us for the greatest party Atom Universe has ever seen!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/best-memories-contest-copy.jpg

We know you have some amazing memories of your time here in Atom Universe, and as we approach our first birthday we want you to share them with us! Take part in our latest competition to win an individualised bundle of clothing and accessories. More details can be found on our facebook page. We can't wait to hear/see your fondest memories! Good Luck!



The Sky's the Limit!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Altered-Sky.png

notes.title: Dev Blog #73 Happy Birthday, Atom Universe! Start the celebrations with a free surprise!
notes.content:
Hi there!

It’s hard to believe that Atom Universe will celebrate its first year this month - on the 23rd September, to be precise! It’s been such an exciting journey and we are really grateful for your support. You guys are awesome!

In this week’s blog we will share with you some of our memories of this adventure and give you some hints on the awesome things we have been planning to celebrate the big day.

We also have a surprise for every AU player, exciting news about one of our featured artists, plus some new items in the game from midnight tonight! You can read more about these below.



So Many Memories...


We were so thrilled when we achieved our Kickstarter target back in April 2015. We always knew that our fans were really behind us and the backers were truly amazing. It was time to start turning Atom Universe into reality!

Many of you will remember our concept art from those days, but in case you missed it...


http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Blog-1-image-1.png


As well as building the environment, the next big challenge was bringing the Avatars to life. Not an easy task for us poor humans without any godlike powers! Pixel by pixel, from a generic head and body to Adam and Eve.


http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Blog-1-image-2a.png

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Blog-1-image-4a.png


So many crazy outfits, so many competitions, so many design ideas from our community, so many Block Parties! Such a brilliant year.


http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Blog-1-image-6a.png


It’s Party Time!


It’s been such an amazing adventure so far, and yet it’s just the beginning of a long and awesome journey together. You constantly inspire us with your enthusiasm, suggestions and ideas and we’re looking forward to expanding the universe.

It’s time for celebrations! One day wouldn’t be enough, get ready a few weeks of fun (and new content!). And save the date for the 23rd September (and the whole weekend)!

So to get you in the party mood, here's a lovely surprise for everyone...



Free 2 week subscription for all!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/2-week-sub.jpg


So the celebrations start here! Log in to the game any time this weekend (9th and 10th September) and you will be rewarded with a free 2-week subscription. The subscription will start as soon as you log in so you can take advantage of all the subscriber perks straight away.

Subscribers have access to extra spaces, clothing, accessories, dances and poses for the length of the subscription, so you can kit yourself out in a new outfit and bust out some special moves! Everyone get line dancing!

But not only do subscribers get extra items and spaces, they also get 10% off all in-game purchases. So your molecules go further while you are a subscriber. Time to treat yourself to something awesome!

Don't forget, the new Research Center club space will be available to all subscribers on 16th and 17th September when we host an open house. So take advantage of your free subscription to get a sneak peek at this new space. You can read more about the Research Center in dev blog #72.



Another First For Atom Universe - Altered Sky Party!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Altered-Sky.png

This weekend check out the Arcade Plaza for our very first 'rock block'! It's a space dedicated to the music of one of our favourite artists - Altered Sky. We are so excited about this, and so are and Altered Sky! Check out the Altered Sky facebook page for more details. All are welcome, and don't forget to wear your Altered Sky t-shirt to show your support. We want to say a massive thanks to the band for sharing their music with us all!



Shopping Spree!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/skull-t-shirts.jpg


We have been looking forward to getting these next few items in the game for a while! First of all, check out these awesome skull t-shirts for Adam and Eve! We love their style, a little grungy, a little mysterious and totally ROCK! We have a new pair of hotpants that come with knee high boots for Eve and a pair of shorts with a palm tree design for Adam. All are colour customisable and a brilliant addition to your AU wardrobe!


http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/non-cust-basketball.jpg


Plus we have some non-customisable versions of two of our most popular shirts. The basketball top for Adam and the cheerleader crop top for Eve. If you haven't already bought one of these, maybe we can tempt you with these black versions. Because black goes with everything ;)





Hope you enjoyed the trip down memory lane, and hope you enjoy the new items :)

See you on the dance floor!

notes.title: Dev Blog #72 - Subscriber highlights, Beautiful Bikinis and something new...
notes.content:
Hi there!

This week's dev blog features the latest subscriber items; plus more content is released into the game at midnight tonight (UK time), and we have something completely new to tell you about!
This Month's Subscriber Treats
We have a brand new item for Adam, a colour-customisable polo shirt. You have our official permission to rock that smart-casual vibe, it is dress-down Friday after all!
We bring Eve her own version of the popular stripy zipped trousers. Again these are colour customisable, choose which colour to compliment the black stripes. Red looks good, or green, or turquoise or purple or...you get the picture!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/31st-Aug-subscrition-items-copy.jpg

This month's moves for subscribers includes 'The Slide' dance (you should recognise this one), plus an 'OK' and a shocked pose. Like O-M-G!
Bikinis are here!
Hurrah! It's time to cheer as we have two brand new bikinis in game for all you lovely Eve players.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/31st-Aug-items-copy.jpg

Feast your eyes on these two cheeky designs, we have a fruit pattern and a sunshine pattern. Guaranteed to brighten your day! This is a completely new style of bikini, a little less sporty, and a bit more beach ready. The little ties on the bottoms are sooooo cute!

The top and the bottom are separate garments, so you can wear them as a complete outfit or mix and match them with your other favourite items.

What's more, they're customisable so you can choose your favourite colour!

For Adam we have these quirky logo t-shirts, available in patterned sleeve and plain sleeve versions. They look a little like pyjamas, so pair them with the sweatpants, get comfy and settle down for a sleepover!
Snap and chat!
Get your selfie face ready for these beauties! Strike a pose with the butterfly crown for subscribers or the flower crown available to all! They are both colour customisable and look (I believe the expression is...) - on fleek!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/31st-Aug-accessories-copy.jpg

You might remember our poll winner from June was the straw fedora, well here it is! This classy little number is perfect for those long summer days, team it with a pair of sunglasses for a masterclass in cool.

We also have a cute little checkerboard wristband available to everyone for free! Oh yeah!
Shiny New Ideas - Clubs
We are delighted to announce that we are taking our first steps towards a clubs feature in Atom Universe. We have started by providing a clubhouse space for one of our communities. It's still very early days, so at the moment it is just a space to explore. But we hope as it develops the clubs feature will be able to deliver what our communities need; helping them thrive.

Some lucky users will be able to go on a tour of the new Research Center from tonight at midnight (UK time) if they are part of the community that contributed it. It will be accessible to all subscribers during our open house weekend on 16th and 17th September.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/research-center-copy.jpg

The Research Center is a unique space, chosen by the community involved and brought to us ready to go. If you are interested in starting a community in Atom Universe and getting access to your own clubhouse, you could start by having a look on the Unreal Marketplace (or similar sites) for inspiration of the kinds of spaces that you could bring to the game.

Then contact us to propose your ideas and find out about how we can collaborate to bring it to life. You provide the space, we can put it in the game! Send us a message via clubs@atomrepublic.com to find out more.
Bundles
We are pleased to announce that bundles are coming to Europe! They are now available to all PS4 users via the PS Store. If you are just getting started or know someone who is just dipping their toe into the AU waters these are a great value way to kickstart your collection of items.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/DLC_Bundle-copy-copy.jpg

	DLC Bundle - Contains Japanese Pack, Halloween Pack and Medieval Pack of items.
	Taster Bundle - Contains 1 Month Premier Subscription, 199 Molecules, Japanese Pack of items.
	Total Bundle - Contains 1 Year Premier Subscription, 3999 Molecules, Japanese pack, Halloween Pack and Medieval Pack of items.

Sign up for our email updates
Is your email ready for this? As well as our newsletter we also send out vital communications via email, plus information about offers and gifts for you. Make sure you have an email registered with us so that we can keep in touch.

If you haven't done it already, you can register and verify your email when you first log in to Atom Universe. Enter your email into the box and click register email. Click verify email; then check you email, click the verification link and you are all done!
Tune in!
We hope you are enjoying the latest music in the Arcade Plaza. We love the original music we are able to bring you- don't forget to support the artists by wearing their t-shirt in game.

Check out a snippet of our current playlist below!

	Veela: Majesty
	AudioBruz: For the Good, For the Better
	Bonnie X Clyde: The Ride
	Crystal knives: Wylin
	Dance with the dead: Blind

Known Issues
We are still aware of the lag issues encountered in busy spaces, and so maximum server sizes will remain reduced while we work on this.

notes.title: Dev Blog #71 - New patch is here! Say hello to 0.9.0.4150
notes.content:
Guess what Atomians?

IT'S UPDATE TIME!

Version 0.9.0.4150 will be released today at 1:30pm (UK time) and it contains all this lovely lovely stuff! 

Remember I told you something exciting was coming? Well get ready, there's lots to read...



Right here, right now!

https://www.youtube.com/embed/tQPn-QfiEPg


We are so overwhelmingly excited to tell you all about this new improvement. It is now possible to change your outfit and buy new items without having to leave the space you are in! That's right, the menu to do this is now on the touchpad button (or space for PC users), meaning instant access to your wardrobe.

Check out the video above to see it in action!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Atom-Universe_20170821070545.jpg 

Change your outfit to match your mood or your destination. Show your allegiance to your friends by sporting the same cool accessory. Be the darling couple of AU by coordinating your date outfits. Compare your latest purchases, and show off your extensive collection. Like what you see? Buy it and put it on straight away! And best of all avoid that horrible moment when you realise you and someone else are wearing the same dress!

You can also change your gender and skin tone in this menu.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Atom-Universe_20170821070941.jpg 

Customise on the fly with our new player menu. So many creative possibilities now unlocked and available to you, wherever you are in Atom Universe!

We think this is pretty handy, and we hope you do too!




Would you like to see the menu?


There are other improvements to the menus that we need to tell you about. Quite a bit has changed about the way you access many of the features, so spread the word and help people out if they get confused!

We have two menus in the game, one is called the Player Menu, and the other is the Action Menu.

Use the Action Menu if you want to pose, dance or change your emoji/flag. Press square (or Tab for PC users) and use the menu in the same way you have before. We have simplified this menu so that you can get to the section you want much quicker.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/action-menu.jpg 

Use the Player Menu (press touchpad or space) to buy items, customise your avatar, access the social features, view your stickerbook or travel to other spaces.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/player-menu-image.jpg 

If you were wondering about chat, it's still on triangle (or Alt for PC users), that hasn't changed.

At first it might take a little getting used to, but enjoy your new menus!




There's More to Explore in Aurora Private Islands

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/aurora-scrapbook.png


Your own Private Aurora just got bigger! We have added a cluster of three new islands, providing more tranquil space, a picnic spot and a funky dancefloor! This new improved space also includes exclusive furniture items. Gather around the campfire, set out your beach furniture and watch the glorious fireworks decorate the beautiful night-time sky. Bring your friends to enjoy this wonderful space!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/aurora-pi-furniture.png

It's a lovely surprise for those who supported us by buying Aurora Private Islands, thank you for your contribution to Atom Universe!




Spinning Around

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/fidget.jpg 


We have a new toy for you to play with! Visit Arcade Plaza or The Hub and seek out the new fidget spinner game. Test your button-pressing prowess and set your fastest speed! Compete with other users by making it onto the global leaderboard! Or just use it to pass the time while you wait for your friends.

notes.title: Dev Blog #69 - Luscious Locks, Poll Winners and Community Corner
notes.content:

Stand out from the crowd and bring a big splash of colour to your world.

Cash me if you can
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Money-hats.jpg

Day of the Tentacle
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Tentacle-Earring.jpg

Back in May we asked you to vote on a new style of earrings to add to the game. They look so cool in the dark spaces...perhaps we need more dark spaces, hmmmm.... ?

Remember we do a community vote or competition every month, so make sure you keep an eye on our facebook page for more details of the next one. Get involved and have a say about what we create for the game!

Get Sporty
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Sports-t-shirts.jpg

Did you know the World Athletics Championships are on at the moment? Why not celebrate with our running t-shirt? And if running isn't for you, we have new tennis and cycling ones too, all in simple but sweet designs with customisable colours.

Community Spotlight
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/thank-you.jpg

We have an active community here in AU and we want everyone to know how special our members are. We want to thank our wonderful moderators who help keep things ticking over nicely; our amazing guides who help and welcome people every day; our fantastic content creators who make awesome videos to spread the word about Atom Universe; our lovely forum members who make ace suggestions; and our super community leaders who create events and competitions.

And of course we also want to thank everyone who drops by each day to play games, boogie or chat!

It's a lot of people to thank, but we really mean it! Thank you!

The next community event is this weekend, have a look here for more details. Hosted by JFCVC, it's a house party with an open invitation to all, but places are limited so check out the details and RSVP soon! Have fun if you take part!

That's all for now! Don't forget to grab your rainbow wristband, and I'll see you here next week for some exciting news about our next update. Oooooohhhh..... ;)

Buh bye!

notes.title: Dev Blog #68 - Share the love! Check out your free gift
notes.content:
Hey hey! 

Welcome to this week's devblog! How have you been? Hope you've been enjoying the new challenges :D

Are you ready for some new content?

Let's go!



Our most exciting news is that we have made big improvements to our stability! Crashes and server timeouts will be much rarer, leaving you to hang out with your friends for longer without interruption! We have also increased the number of players in each public server again, so you are more likely to bump into your crew. Plus, we have new items for you to try, they are scheduled to burst into the game at midnight tonight (UK time).


Crashes fixed

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/WristSweatbandsRainbow.jpg


We know that a lot of you have had a frustrating time trying to stay in the game recently. We apologise for this unfortunate period and we are overjoyed to report that with a lot of hard work and dedication from the AU team, these issues have now been fixed! AU is running smoothly, purring like a contented kitten.

But we know it hasn't been much fun to lose connection or not be able to log in.

So we wanted to say sorry; and thank you for your patience by giving you a limited edition exclusive item. Pop into the customisation screen before 23:59pm (UK time) on Thursday 10th August and trade in 1 Atom to claim your freebie rainbow design sweatband. Spread peace, love and happiness with this colourful design!

A happy ending at the end of the rainbow!


Zip it!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ZippedJeans-copy.jpg


Look out for more varieties of the zipped trousers heading your way. There is a plain non customisable version for Adam and Eve, and a customisable version for Adam. Customisable versions will follow soon for Eve, we haven't forgotten her!


More zip jokes

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/newItems-copy.jpg


Instead, Eve is getting this awesome customisable lace bodice, and a skirt with zip motifs. So she can still get zippy! 

Speaking of zippy, if you are a subscriber, Eve now has sneakers to wear! So she can zip all round the place, and Adam can do it in comfort with these sweatpants. Or he could just lounge about on the sofa... sweeeeeeet.

I think we got that all zipped up. Zip-Zip Hooray! 

Let's move on.
 


Bow-licious

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Premier-items-copy.jpg


We've been looking forward to releasing this next item for a little while now... DRUM ROLL.....ta-dahhhhh! Check out these super cute bow wings! They're colour customisable so wrap yourself up like a present and put a big smile on everyone's faces.

Subscribers can also wear these stars head boppers, perfect for a party or when pretending you are a disco alien. Which, we know you all do from time to time ;)



Support your favourite artists

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/K-391BandTshirt-copy.png


This week we bring you a t-shirt celebrating one of our featured artists, K391, who is currently playing in the Arcade Plaza. So grab one and show your support. It's a really cool logo, and best of all it's colour customisable and completely free!




I can be your hero, baby...


...by performing the new superhero poses, available for subscribers. Everyone loves watching good summer superhero blockbuster, full of action and adventure; and now we give you the power to BE the hero (saving lives not included ;) )

Check out our elegant hula dance, or get in line with your other subscriber buddies and bust out this new line dance. How many of you can get in perfect synch? We'd love to see your screengrabs if you can gather 10 or more friends. There's an extra challenge for you!



Well have a great weekend! See you on the dance floor!







Bug Fixes

	How'd that get back in there? We have removed the sound from the video screen in Aurora again, so it shouldn't be so loud in there!
	






Known Issues

	Tracksuit Bottoms have some clipping issues when work with a long t shirt
	Non-customisable zipped Jeans have a colour wheel which implies that they can be customised, but they cannot.
	Rainbow wristband sometimes has a small clipping issue on the inside of Adam's wrist.

notes.title: Dev Blog #67 - New Patch 0.8.0, collect those Gold orbs!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Atomians!

Woohoo! 0.8.0.4150 is here! It's time for another update :)

We can't wait to share the cool stuff with you, so here we go- time to unwrap the latest patch...
Gold Orbs have Arrived!!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Atom-Universe_20170719121634.jpg

We've added a new challenge to Orb Runner so it's time to put your gold goggles into action!

Remember the gold orbs from the original Aurora? Well they've made it here to AU too...and they're still red :D
So it's time to start collecting these 50-point beasts.

If you own the gold goggles (what do you mean you haven't earned them yet? ;) ) the gold orbs will magically appear when playing Orb Runner. Then you can work towards the 'Strike Gold' challenges. There is something rather special as the reward for this so don't delay...see if you can be the first of your friends to win it!

If you don't own them yet, it's time you started collecting those silver orbs! To help you get cracking we decided to not charge you any atoms to play for another month! In future, Orb Runner will be like our other games which require our free in-game currency to play. So make the most of it- go play Orb Runner- RIGHT NOW :D
Smash the New Challenges!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/WelcomeScreen_rewards.png

As well as the new Orb Runner challenge, we have even more challenges for you to play! We are so excited to announce that we have added three awesome challenges to our arcade game, Atom Smasher. We can't wait to see you earning your stickers and winning your rewards.
Spooky Time
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Costumes4-copy-1.png

Hot on the heels of the male skeleton costume last patch, we have added two new spooky costumes for Adam and Eve. If you feel like there's some haunting to be done, you can become a ghost; or if it's a little covert spying you need, then maybe the invisible character will do the trick.

You told us that Eve players wanted a skeleton of their own, so we are delighted to say we listened to your feedback and a female version is available now!

If you already purchased the male skeleton before the 0.8.0 patch came out, then keep an eye on your costumes tab for a nice little surprise!
Dance like no one's watching...
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/dances-menu-copy.jpg

There's a cheeky new tab added to the Avatar menu called Dances & Poses. Here you can see all the dances and poses available in game and you can preview them to see how they look on your avatar. From this menu you can also purchase dance packs and check out the selection of poses and dances available for subscribers.
Ever wondered what that awesome dance was that you saw someone doing? Now you can do your research here!

If any of these mysterious new dances take your fancy, check out our subscription page for more information. While you're there you'll find there's a whole bunch of perks available for subscribers, not just extra dances and poses!

Have a look at our latest video and see if any of these funky moves catch your eye!



What an awesome update! Have fun completing the new challenges and checking out the new spooky costumes!

That's all from me, see you next week!
Bug Fixes

	Stability improvements, crashes/kicks should occur far less often
	Orb Runner Silver Orbs now reward 25 points and are called 'Silver'

Known Issues

	We have disabled some t-shirts while we improve stability - these will return once we have finished maintenance work on them
	Orb Runner Gold Goggles will not appear as owned in the Orb Runner Menu as soon as you have completed the Tier 5 Silver Searcher challenge. Going back to the main menu will make them appear

notes.title: Dev Blog #65 - New Clothes!
notes.content:
Hey Hey!

Time for a cute little dev blog featuring fresh new content for Adam and Eve, available from midnight tonight! (UK time)


Summer-summer-summertime!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Summer-Tshirt-design-copy.jpg


Summer is officially here in AU as we announce the arrival of the 'Ultimate Summer Experience' T-shirt. You may remember back in May (Dev Blog #55) we invited you to take part in a competition to design a t-shirt that will appear in the game. The winner was Latannia Butterfield and we are delighted to say that it will be appearing in game tonight (UK time).

We want to thank Latannia and all those who took part in the competition. To celebrate our wonderful community we are giving this t-shirt away for free so that we can share it with you all. We hope to see you all wearing it and basking in its summer vibes!

We hope to do more competitions like this in the future so keep an eye on our social media channels for details of the next one.



Wear the universe...

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Galaxy-T-shirts-copy.jpg


What better way to represent Atom Universe than with our new galaxy print t shirts. You can choose our original purple design for the ultimate space-nerd look (just like our main menu ;) ) or splash out on a customisable version and see what wonderful colour combinations you can create. Perfect for standing out from the crowd!




So as I said, it's a cute one this week- short but sweet.

Now you can get back to playing Orb Runner ;)

See you next week!

notes.title: Dev Blog #64 - For your body and your brains...
notes.content:
Happy Thursday dearest Atomians!

Time to get excited - Thursday means a new dev blog, and midnight tonight (UK time) means more content released into the game!
Make sure you pop by to check out the new items, then head down to the Arcade Plaza to show them off :)

Music to our ears
This week we are highlighting one of our popular artists, Flawless, and we are giving away a t-shirt for free! Flawless regularly plays on the big screen in the Arcade Plaza. If you are a Hip-hop fan you can show you support by wearing his logo, which appears on the front and back of this awesome shirt. Don't forget that we also have free t-shirts for Altered Sky and Dear Agony with many more to come in future releases. Keep it black for the ultimate in cool, or colour-customise it for a more unique look. We love the music that we are able to bring you in the game, and we are proud to share these exciting artists with you!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/6th-July-2017-flawless-copy.png
Casual cool
Try on our new stripy t-shirts, this time with fat stripes. Keep the white and customise the coloured stripe for effortless cool or customise both stripes for that personal touch. Eve players can team this with the new skinny jeans which are ripped on the knee.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/stripy-shirts-and-jeans-copy.png

I'm sure you will love this zip-up patterned bodice for Eve and this trendy headphones t-shirt for Adam. If you are still looking for something summery, Adam players can wear the non-customisable Hawaiian shirt for a burst of colourful beach vibes.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/6th-July-2017-copy.jpg
Test your brains
Time for a little nostalgia...do you remember the Brainiacs' Challenge? Our awesome moderator Steven is bringing it back and it's going to be all about Atom Universe! Compete with AU players across the globe to see who is the most knowledgeable about the game. We want to say huge thanks to Steven for running the competition. For more details and to take part, visit our forum. The current round closes at 11pm CT tomorrow night so don't miss out. Good luck!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Brainiac.png
And the winner is...
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/glasses.jpg

We are delighted to announce that the winner of our latest poll was the Swag Aviator glasses.
We are going to get started on these and you can expect them to come your way in a future update. Thank you to all who took the time to vote. Look out for our next poll starting very soon.

Logging in bug
We know a few of you had difficulty logging in recently, so we got right on that and fixed the issue. We are sorry if you weren't able to play for a while. If you are still having issues, make sure you have version 0.7.1.4150 installed, and if you still have issues after that, make sure you let us know through our support channel. Email support@atomrepublic.com with your username and more information about the problem and we will look into it for you.

That's all for now, have a great weekend!

notes.title: Dev Blog #63 Cave House Sale! Plus Celebrating, Sun Bathing and Bug Squishing
notes.content:
Hello I'm back, with more juicy news!!
Cave House Sale!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/CaveHouse2.png

This weekend only the Cave House private space will be available for HALF PRICE!

Cave House is a modern minimalist space with two floors, an infinity pool and a secret cave below! There is a wide variety of chic furniture available to purchase so that you can decorate your space, and Cave House also boasts many interactions; how about taking a bath, working in the hidden kitchen or changing the sky from day to night?

Hang out on the balcony listening to the seagulls and watching the waves crash against the rocks; or take a dip in the exhilarating infinity pool. Step right in and feel like there is nothing between you and the vast expanse of the ocean. It's the perfect place to become one with nature.

Then take your friends down in the glass lift to explore the dark caverns beneath. Light a fire and tell spooky stories to each other. Are you brave enough to turn off the lights?

The Cave House sale runs from 9am Saturday 1st July until 9am Monday 3rd July (UK time), so grab it while you can at this amazing price!
Beautiful Aurora
We hope you are having an amazing time exploring Aurora, collecting orbs and completing challenges. It's great to see you there having fun and making new friends. We are so happy that we could finally release Aurora for everyone, and we want to thank all those who bought Aurora Private Islands, your contribution helped make this happen and YOU ARE AWESOME!

[caption id="attachment_4109" align="alignnone" width="3840"]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Atom-Universe_20170628151910.jpg Colourful bunting in Aurora Private Islands[/caption]

You might have noticed we added a couple of extra decorative touches to Aurora Private Islands; and we will be adding more in the future, so it will not be forgotten. Don't forget to boogie away on the special dance floor that was part of the Aurora Private Islands pack. If you haven't found the secret spot away from Aurora Private Islands where you can place it and show it off to everyone; then here's a clue...it's somewhere hot!

[caption id="attachment_4110" align="alignnone" width="3840"]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Atom-Universe_20170628152132.jpg Remember that boat...?[/caption]
New Patch - Version 0.7.1.4150
Unfortunately our latest patch had a few issues that we wanted to sort out straight away. May I present to you version 0.7.1.4150, coming your way on Friday 30th June!

As well as the bug fixes, we have lots of new items available from midnight tonight (29th June/UK time), so make sure you pop into the Avatar tabs to check them out!
Let's Celebrate!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Dev-Banner-1.jpg

With Canada Day and Independence Day just around the corner we wanted to help you mark the occasion. Pick up one of our Canada Day hats or t-shirts for the 1st July, or an Independence Day hat or t-shirt for the 4th July to celebrate.
Hit the Beach
We are feeling the heat here in the UK right now, so it's perfect timing for us to release some awesome new summer items. Your avatar will love showing off their beach bod in these. Plus it's always glorious weather in AU, notice how we haven't got any umbrellas? ;)

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Dev-Banner-2.jpg

We have shorts!!! Woohoo!!!
Subscribers will find the shorts and swimshorts for Adam, and hot pants and a new patterned sports bikini for Eve.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Dev-Banner-3.jpg

For relaxing by the bar after a day of sunbathing we have a tropical Hawaiian shirt for Adam, and Eve has a new patterned pleated skirt, perfect if you want more of an alternative look.

We also have a gorgeous bow headband which is so super cute. With the Wimbledon Tennis Championships starting soon, we thought you might like to show you have tennis on the brain with our wacky tennis-ball head!

Subscribers will also have access to 7 new poses. Eve will show us how to work it with Fashion 1,2,3 and 4 poses, while Adam brings out his tough side with Gangsta poses - hand on heart, fist and open hands.
Can You Hear Voices..?
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/headset_skype_microphone-2.png

If you haven't tried it out already, don't forget that you can now use voice chat in the game. At the moment it is available in private spaces only, and it is still in the early stages of development so we want to know what you think.

If you open chat in a private space and have a headset/mic plugged in you will be able to hear other players and talk to them. We know this means you can't walk and talk right now with this version, this is something we would want to improve in the future.
It's just a test version at the moment so we know it's not perfect yet! Head on over to our forum here to read more and give us your feedback.

Have fun with the new items, enjoy Cave House, and see you on the dancefloor!
Bug Fixes
The video screen in Aurora no longer plays music
Chat no longer closes randomly
Notifications will no longer duplicate themselves
It is no longer possible to get out of the map and fall off the islands in Aurora

notes.title: Dev blog #62 - Aurora is Here!!!
notes.content:
Hello Atomians!

We are straight into it this week as we have one of our biggest patches to date. Version 0.7.0.4150 is very very very special and will go live tomorrow!!
Huge News!
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/Aurora_Logo.jpg

Seriously, drop everything- Aurora is here for everyone!
It's a new free public space for you to enjoy, and most exciting of all - it has the Orb Runner game!

https://youtu.be/NXWyxPQtJro

Aurora is a floating archipelago, full of whimsy and wonder. These quirky islands in the sky give you lots of space to explore, play or dream. Sit and relax while the sun goes down to reveal a beautiful vista of a million stars. Get active and play Orb Runner, collect as many of the orbs as you can for a high score. Laze in the long grass and watch the many balloons hover in the picture perfect sky. Feel at one with nature while butterflies flutter past you as you wander around this beautiful sunny space.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/OrbRunner-copy.jpg

We have given you some challenges to help you get the most out of Orb Runner. Two tricky tests await you, and if you are good enough, you will receive exclusive rewards. Those that remember the previous incarnation of Aurora will probably remember some of the rewards too! We hope they will be a lovely nostalgic surprise for you; and for others, a fun little gift.

If you have purchased Aurora Private Islands you will have a head start on the Orb Runner challenges with your silver goggles. And if you haven't, don't worry - you can earn the silver goggles by playing Orb Runner.

Have fun and check out the stickerbook to find out more about the challenges.

We know many of you have been looking forward to seeing Aurora come to life again. We are so excited to bring this to Atom Universe and cannot wait to see you all there!
The Collector
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/AquavengerStickerBookPage.jpg

So how is your stickerbook looking? Ready for more stickers??? Well this is the patch for you! As well as the Orb Runner challenges we are also adding challenges to another of our Arcade Cabinets - Aquavenger! Get stuck in and rise to the challenge. For each challenge you master you will receive a unique reward so you can show off your skills and look super cool on your visits to AU.
Keep on Dancin'
http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/KpopDances.jpg

Time to rip up the dancefloor with our next pack of awesome dance moves. The K-Pop Cowboy Dances pack features 3 zany moves that you will recognise and we are sure you will have so much fun performing them, whether it's in synch with a friend or in a dance off style against your rivals. They come with a cute little pair of winged trainers - awesome!

notes.title: Dev Blog #58 - Aurora and a whole bunch of exciting new content
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This week's dev blog is a big one, packed full of juicy details. So let's dive straight in! We will bring you update version 0.6.0.4150 on Monday 29th May 2017 at 9AM UK time, and this is what's new: http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/nDreams_Aurora_Logo.png




	It's finally here!




	So we asked you to keep a secret and to be honest, not many of you were very good at it! Perhaps our hot air balloon hint was a little too good. Rumors started to fly that we were bringing back Aurora, a much loved space from 'the past'. Finally we can reveal that this is exactly what we are doing! Starting with the Aurora Private Islands Bundle, we are reviving this popular space and bringing it into Atom Universe. It's quite a big project so you can expect much more to happen with Aurora in the future, but for now we would like to invite you to purchase your own Aurora private space and bring all your friends! As part of the bundle you will get two of Aurora's islands to explore; plus two exclusive items, an Aurora t-shirt (just like old times) and a dancefloor for you to place in your Private Islands space (and also somewhere else, but we are going to let you discover that by yourselves). Not only that but you will also receive a set of the famous goggles from Aurora. We are giving you the silver goggles so that when we get Orb Runner up and running you can have a head start in completing the daily challenge! While you wait for Orb Runner to arrive you are going to look so super snazzy wearing them. http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/AuroraPrivateIslands-.jpg By purchasing the Aurora Private Islands Bundle you will be directly contributing towards bringing Aurora to Atom Universe for everyone, including minigames, clothing, furniture and more! We are so excited to be able to bring this space to Atom Universe and to share it with you! You can read more about how we made this happen here. Aurora Private Islands Bundle: Private space with two Aurora islands Aurora T-shirt Dance Floor Furniture item Silver Goggles




	Collect 'em all!




	The exciting news doesn't stop there! We know you have enjoyed playing Holo-Horses to complete the challenges, and now we are going to give you more! In this update we will be adding challenges and rewards to Bowling. Time to spice it up a little. We know that you have mastered each of the mini games in Atom Universe, but now we are giving you some new tasks to complete to show you are the ultimate AU gamer. To earn these rewards it really takes dedication and skill - so if you want to be the best, take on these challenges. Then wear your rewards with pride! We have also created a stickerbook for you to access in game which will show your progress towards all the current challenges, and give you a sticker when you complete each one. In true stickerbook style, some of them are shiny, so make sure you earn them all! http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Sticker-book-cover.jpg We will be adding more challenges over time, so keep an eye on your stickerbook to see when new ones drop. http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Sticker-book-inside.jpg We can't wait to hear about your progress, grab a screenshot and share it with us @AtomRepublic on Twitter.




	A little helping hand




	We know that it can be a little confusing for new players when they first enter the game. We have quite a few menus to browse through at the start, and lots of options to choose from! So we decided to add a tutorial which will explain things a little and help them get started. The tutorial will play for everyone the first time you play the game after it has been updated. If you are an AU pro, you can skip each part of the tutorial quickly. And if you decide that maybe there is something useful to learn after all, you can make it play again by clicking on the ? button in the bottom left hand corner. Sorted. We love it when new players join our community and we hope that our tutorial coupled with your friendliness will help make AU even better!




	I Robot




	http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Costumes2.jpg





	Look out for these awesome new android costumes, available for Adam and for Eve. They offer two levels of colour customisation for the rippling lights and eye/tattoo features. Maybe you have been sent from the 25th century to wreak some kind of revenge. Or maybe you are a friendly robot just here to dance, that's up to you! 




	Design Competition




	http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/tshirt-summer.jpg





	We absolutely loved hosting our first design competition. We asked you guys to design a logo which encapsulated the ultimate summer experience. You lot didn't disappoint, and we cannot wait to hold another comp to see more of your talent. Our winner this time was Latannia Butterfield with the design above. We are already working on it and you can expect to see this in game soon. The t-shirt will be free to all and we love it!




	Custom Made




	http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/ItemsRequests.png





	We know that there are some players that would appreciate a much more bespoke experience in AU. We are excited to launch a very special service, where you can request a new item or design and we will contact you to discuss what it will take to get it into the game. Maybe you would like to promote your you tube channel, have a go at creating a cool design, or maybe you just want something that no one else has! You can access this feature via the Item Requests tab in the Avatar menu.




	Fly the flag




	It wouldn't be a devblog without some clothing updates! This time we are adding more flag t-shirts so that players from the following countries can REPRESENT!!! Belgium, Netherlands, Ireland, Argentina, Russia, Norway, Mexico, New Zealand, Greece and Japan. http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/NewFlagTshirts.jpg Grab yours now!




	Phew!




	If you read this far you are a true AU hero :) Thanks to those of you who joined us in the Woodland House last weekend for our open house event. We hope to do more of these in the future so keep an eye on our social media channels for more info. Don't forget we now release new content each week, so remember to regularly check in and see what's new. Hope you enjoy all the cool stuff, byeeeee for now!




	Bug Fixes:



	
		Avatar items will no longer reset when you travel to a space or restart the game.
	
	
		Other players will once again be able to see what you are wearing correctly.
	
	
		Users can no longer preview clothing on an avatar wearing a costume.
	




	




	Known Issue:




	Sometimes when you preview items in the customisation screen they don't disappear when you move your cursor away from the thumbnail. While we work on a fix for this, you can refresh the screen by pressing the touchpad or spacebar to remove the previewed item.

notes.content:

At Atom HQ we are starting to feel the effects of the warmer weather and longer days, and suddenly we are feeling all kinds of summery! One lucky winner will be chosen and their design will be added to the game!

notes.title: DevBlog #53 - What's going to be in our upcoming update?
notes.content:
Greetings,

Welcome to our latest edition of the Atom Republic DevBlog. This week, we’ll be taking a closer look at what’s going to be included our next update (v4.11.4132).  So, let’s get to the juicy information, shall we? 

Holo Horses is due to open! 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot.jpg

Our latest mini-game in the Arcade Plaza is opening for the first time. Known as Holo Horses, it’s time to take to the race track and place bets on your favourite horses. This will allow you to place Atoms on your chosen racer and if you’re lucky, you could win big!
 
Holo Horses will also introduce the first iteration of challenges. By completing these challenges, you’ll be able to unlock some pretty cool rewards for your avatar.

Atom Smasher is coming to the VIP Area 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot2.jpg

The next instalment of our Arcade mini-games will soon be available to play in the VIP Area, located in the Arcade Plaza. Atom Smasher is a throwback to one of our favourite retro-style games where you are required to smash as many boxes as you possibly can before the boxes cross the line.  Collect power-ups, avoid the boxes containing the penalty powers and try to set the highest score for bragging rights.

Main Menu UI Revamp 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot3.jpg

With the latest update, one the first things you might recognise is that our main menu has completely changed. No longer will you be required to travel from screen-to-screen looking to join public or private spaces, trying to find the avatar customisation screen or even trying to find the option. 

This new update will add a whole new level of simplicity to navigating our main menu. Now everything is accessible on one screen and you will allow you to navigate between different tabs by pressing the L1 & R1 buttons.
 
Easter Lost & Found Content 

With Easter just around the corner, we’ll be putting a unique twist on the Lost & Found mini-game. From the next update, we’ll be replacing all the collectables with Easters Eggs. This will essentially make the Lost & Found mini-game become an Easter Egg Hunt, fun huh? 
 
New Animations 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/edited3.jpg

Premier members are going to gain three brand new animations to show off. Firstly, the Vulcan Salute pose is going to be available alongside with the Jumpstyle 4 and 5 dance animations. Secondly, the Facepalm pose will soon be available for free members of Atom Universe.
 
New Clothing 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/edited4.jpg

As a Premier Member, you will also be gaining some new items of clothing to your wardrobes. Male and Female avatars will have the stylish Varsity Jacket to wear.  Free members will also be able to find the seasonal Easter T-Shirts within their wardrobes. 

Male avatars will also be able to find a new casual looking shirt available in the Atom Universe Store.
 
Lastly, remember EmeraldPhoenix’s suggestions for Sandals? We’re happy to announce that these two suggestions are going to be making their appearance in the update.

New Accessories 

Premier members are going to be able to wear a cute beany hat with bunny ears, whereas with free members can soon wear a bunny tail to help get into the Easter spirit. New accessories such as the Bunny Ears Headband and Gas Mask will also be on sale in the Atom Universe store.

New Hairstyles  
In this update, a small handful of new hairstyles will also be added to the Atom Universe Stores for purchase. From the next update onwards you’ll be able to find the Pixie Hair, Wavy Mohawk, Short Bob and Long Ponytail. 

Disable UI 

Following on from the revamp, our Designer has managed to find some time to begin disabling certain parts of the UI. This will allow you to turn off UI and gather screenshots of you and your friends, or maybe you would just like the remove chat boxes from the environment.

This is a first implementation of the disable UI and we’re aware that some elements of the UI will remain (such as interactions in the Cave House, or commands near the chairs and mini-games). We’re aiming to remove these from the UI within a future update. 

Inverted Y-Axis 

The final mention in this week’s DevBlog is related to a much-asked feature from the Atom Universe Community and we’re happy to announce that the Inverted Y-Axis suggestion is going to be implemented into the upcoming update.  Once released, this setting can be activated/deactivated from the settings menu.

notes.title: DevBlog #50 - New Animations and Clothing in the works
notes.content:
Greetings, welcome to our slightly late DevBlog! 

Following on from our previous entry, this week we’ll be taking a closer look at the development team’s latest content that’s planned to be making an appearance in Atom Universe in the not too distant future. 

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Head-Accessories.jpg

Accessories

Premier Members will be gaining access to two new accessories in the next update. Firstly, the Atom Republic Dogtags -  this accessory will only be available to wear for players who use Adam as their main avatar. Secondly, Diamond Earrings will be available for purchase in our in-game store. Lastly, premier members will be able to wear a warm woolly Pompom Hat for both Adam and Eve.  

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Halter-Dress-and-Baggy-Top.jpg

Clothing
Premier members will also be able to access a stylish Halterneck Dress for players donning the Eve avatar. The Atom Universe store will also be getting some new attire for both Adam and Eve.

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Bottoms.jpg

You will be able to purchase a casual looking Baggy T-shirt and Skinny Jeans for Adam and some slick looking Sports Leggings for Eve. 

Animations

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Animations.jpg

Premier members will be gaining three new dance moves to show off on the dancefloor, known as jumpstyle. Adam and Eve will be able to alternate between three different variations of this dance. Premier members will also be able to use the Love Heart pose for Eve and the V Sign for Adam. Lastly, everyone will be able to use the Thumbs Up pose for Adam and Eve.  

Community Poll

Earlier this week, we closed the polls on our latest Community Suggestion Box for what type of Sandal you would like to see in Atom Universe next. The most popular suggestions being *drumroll* B and C!

http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/winners.jpg

These suggestions are now in the queue to be implemented and we’ll be looking to add them into Atom Universe in the not too distant future. 

Recent Changes to the Atom Universe Servers

Recently, you might have noticed that the personal spaces have vanished from the Public Space tab, and the Hub and Arcade Plaza have vanished from the Private Space tab. We’ve been reviewing how we can best utilise Public and Private spaces. At first glance, we realised that the current set-up is rather confusing and blurs the lines between what’s a public space and what’s a private space.

Now, we’ve decided to go back to the roots of what Public and Private spaces are. Within the Public Spaces tab, you will only find spaces like the Arcade Place and the Hub. Whereas with the Private Spaces tab, you’ll be able to access all of the personal spaces like the Mirage House, Woodlands House, Japanese Garden etc!

You may also have noticed that if you’re using a free account on Atom Universe, you are no longer able to create public servers anymore. If you’re a Premier member you’ll still be able to create public servers for the Hub and Arcade Plaza, however, this isn’t a permanent solution and we’re going to continue to look at ways to return this functionality for all users, while minimising server costs.
